episodes.name: Let the Games Begin!
episodes.overviewEn: Lex Luthor and a team of super-villains in new tech'd up suits arrive at the Hall of Justice to fight the Justice League. In battle, both the heroes and villains are summoned by a mysterious entity.

episodes.name: The Flash vs Gorilla Grodd!
episodes.overviewEn: The Flash and Gorilla Grodd are challenged with searching for a data core hidden in the jungle of Skartaris. Will The Flash be fast enough to find it before Gorilla Grodd does?

episodes.name: Green Lantern vs Brainiac!
episodes.overviewEn: Green Lantern is spiralling through an asteroid field when he encounters Brainiac. The two of them are challenged by Technis in a game to claim the data core. Will the data core be used for good or evil?

episodes.name: Superman vs Lex Luthor!
episodes.overviewEn: Superman and Lex Luthor are pitted against each other in a challenge set by Technis. The pair reluctantly agree to team up, but can Superman trust Lex?

episodes.name: Wait, Am I the Brave or Am I the Bold?
episodes.overviewEn: Batman is tasked by Technis to search for the coveted data core in a cave. However, inside the cave are traps set up by his greatest enemy: The Joker!

episodes.name: Batman vs The Joker!
episodes.overviewEn: Batman and Blue Beetle must team up to defeat The Joker and his henchmen. Will our heroes be able to escape the caves before it's too late?

episodes.name: The Contest for Power!
episodes.overviewEn: Wonder Woman must keep the data core from falling into the hands of supervillains!

episodes.name: Galactic Conquest!
episodes.overviewEn: Brainiac and Technis became inseparable. Will the Justice League be able to stop their evil plans to dominate the universe?
